findings.description: Primary list asu-webdir-api-dept1663 (dept_ids=1663, size=200) returned 188 records on one page (meta.total_pages=1, total_results=188). All 137 faculty-class records are in the brief; 51 other records are University Staff, graduate or student-worker roles with no professorial title and are not counted.

Fulton ECEE rank page (asu-ecee-rank) has no person entries in static HTML. Cross-check used the 14 ECEE discipline directory pages (all cited). Every name on those pages matches a brief person after name variants (Ying-Chen Chen, Zhaoyang Fan, Joshua Hihath, Jun Zhang); no omissions. Michael Goryll is on the Fulton pages and is not in the API, as the brief states.

No owner determinations for ASU other than the brief text (Goryll; Jeff Zhang / Jun Zhang identity). No source failures: the list and all cross-check pages were fetched with curl (exit 0) and hashed as the bytes received.
